newsitem.title: CHINA: China starts river shipping development project.
newsitem.headline: China starts river shipping development project.

text.p: China has begun a 2.9 billion yuan ($349 million) project to expand river shipping in southern China, the Xinhua news agency said on Wednesday.
The project involves dredging a 273-km section of the Xijiang River between Nanning in southern Guangxi province and Guangzhou in southern Guangdong province, Xinhua said.
The project, to be completed at the end of 1998, would allow ships of up to 1,000 tonnes to sail between the two cities, Xinhua said.
The expansion is the second phase of a project under which a 574-km section of the river has been dredged, the agency said.
The second phase would include the building of a 120-megawatt hydroelectric station, it said without giving further details.
Funding for the project included an $80 million loan from the World Bank, it said.
